about: SKIR1 (2026-11-11): maps whose usage line is half their fights plus one (tools/skir1/lib_fight_2026_11_11.js ucapOf; tests/skir1-2026-11-11.js), each with its reason: a thin list, or a fight that reached its band (at 200 road games, fit --slack 1) only with a card one fight over the line.
